publisher_traceability.metadata_version_or_crs_accuracy_stateme: No separate metadata version, geolocation accuracy or native datum statement in the inspected publisher documentation; version frozen by repository commit and file SHA256.

mapping_rule: Exact original inventory filename == publisher JSON key == GeoJSON properties.name. No numeric-ID, renamed-file or proximity inference.
coordinate_semantics: Publisher JSON: [upper-left longitude, upper-left latitude, lower-right longitude, lower-right latitude], recorded as [west,north,east,south]; named corner labels in the GeoJSON README example contain a left/right inconsistency, so only the actual point-set extent was checked against the explicit JSON field description.
format_limitations: All509 retained Polygon coordinates are a flat closed array of positions rather than an array of linear-ring arrays; thus they fail RFC7946 Polygon nesting. Original geometry is preserved in filtered copies; no GIS repair, reprojection or geometry operation performed.
GeoJSON coordinate values have up to6 decimal places, JSON parsed decimal representations14-15; coordinate digit counts do not establish spatial accuracy.

No native datum, projection/transform or georeferencing accuracy is explicitly supplied by publisher README. RFC7946 standard WGS84 semantics are not an independent validation of this publisher export.
source_group_limitations: Selected feature properties contain only name; there is no publisher region ID, original-scene ID, per-date parent-scene ID, acquisition date or crop-window lineage.
The release page mentions20 collection regions but provides no file-to-region crosswalk in the inspected metadata.
Distinct filenames and distinct coordinate boxes do not establish independent original scenes; geographic proximity alone would not establish leakage.
Mapping matches saved local filenames. The inspected release does not supply per-image content hashes to additionally establish publisher-to-local pixel identity.
one_irreplaceable_resource: 由发布者确认的509个原train/开发val文件名到原采集区域及两期父场景ID的对应表，说明共享父场景与切片关系，并附可追溯的版本或确认依据。
resource_owner: Dataset publisher or another verifiable custodian of the original collection lineage; no AI or coordinate clustering may fabricate it.
next_action: Wait for that verifiable source crosswalk or explicit new user direction. Do not repeat this completed screen. Any future grouping remains a new proposed protocol requiring its own research question and admission.

license_record.dataset_release_terms: Publisher states images/annotations are academic-only and subject to Google Earth terms.
license_record.usage_scope: Internal academic metadata admission screen; repository software license does not expand the image/annotation terms.
